data.one_liner: Provides Android‑only app usage statistics such as time spent per app.
data.what_it_does: The plugin queries the Android UsageStatsManager to return a list of apps with their usage duration, start/end dates and last foreground time. It works as a singleton accessed via AppUsage().getAppUsage(start, end).
use_when: You need to display how much time the user spent in each app on Android.
You require daily‑level usage data for analytics or parental‑control features.
avoid_when: Precise per‑minute usage is required, as the data is only daily‑level accurate.
strengths: Simple API for retrieving usage stats on Android.
weaknesses: Usage data limited to daily granularity.
Requires special permission (PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS) which may need user to enable manually.
data.setup_notes: Add minSdkVersion >=21, include xmlns:tools in AndroidManifest, and request android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS permission. No additional Dart setup required.
